text:
alice_procure: Heads up — vendor just pushed part of our H100 tranche. Need to sync on impact and RMA flow. PO `PO-78912`, originally 40 units arriving next week, vendor says 24 arrive on time, 16 delayed. Anyone tracking lead-time impact?

diego_vendor: Sorry for the late notice. Freight delay at FRA customs + missing firmware batch flagged. We can split shipment: 24 on the original AWB, 16 on a follow-up air express. We propose 10 replacement loaners now + 6 delayed replacements.

alice_procure: @diego_vendor can you confirm revised ETAs and any cost delta for air express? We need to know if Dedicated pools need scaling down.

diego_vendor: ETA for first AWB ("AWB123456789") unchanged: 2024-11-05 ETA AMS dock. Follow-up AWB ("AWB987654321") ETA now 2024-11-12. Air express surcharge estimate: +$7,500 for the 16 units. We can absorb 50% surcharge if Redwood wants credit instead of faster ship.

ben_logistics: Noted. For the follow-up AWB we'll need pre-alert docs and HS code confirmation. @alice_procure share billing decision so we can finalize booking and insurance.

clara_ops: Cluster side — if 16 arrive a week late, we can rerun capacity shaping. Current buffer is ~18 GPUs free across EU fleet; might have to throttle non-prod canaries for a few days. What about temporary loaners?

emma_sre: If loaners of 10 are available, we can patch queues and avoid canary slowdown. Need serials and firmware level to validate KV-cache compatibility.

diego_vendor: Loaners will be H100-80C serials with firmware 3.2.1. I'll attach manifest. We request return RMA for original faulty batch once replacements arrive.

alice_procure: On RMA — what's vendor policy for DOA / partial-DOA? We need an SLA: turnaround, who pays return freight, and temporary credit.

diego_vendor: Standard: vendor covers return freight for DOA within 30 days; we provide pre-paid RMA labels. For partial-DOA at scale, we do a credit of 1.5% per affected unit on invoice or free loaners until RMA cleared. Turnaround target 7 business days after depot arrival.

ben_logistics: To avoid cross-border VAT/import issues, suggest we route returns to our EU depot (AMS depo). Also request pictures of faulty units and failure logs before RMA label release.

clara_ops: Requesting clear acceptance criteria for SRE to sign off: boot, `nvidia-smi` visible, can run 12GB token infer benchmark at X throughput. If loaners pass, we keep in pool, otherwise they go straight to RMA.

emma_sre: I'll draft a quick check script and post it here. For now, basic checks: firmware match, `nvidia-smi` lists card, no ECC errors, passes token-bench (90% baseline).

diego_vendor: Understood — we'll provide serial photos and upload logs to the secure share. I'll also propose a credits option: either vendor covers full return freight + 25% invoice credit for the delayed 16 units OR Redwood pays surcharge and receives units faster with only standard credit for DOA.

alice_procure: Preference: absorb partial surcharge only for half; accept vendor 50% surcharge cover and 25% credit on invoice for delay. Confirm in writing and update PO amendment.

diego_vendor: Confirmed — vendor accepts 50/50 surcharge split and 25% delay credit on `PO-78912` line items. I'll send amendment and new AWB details by EOD.

rma_bot: [RMA-ALERT] New RMA preflight request created for `PO-78912` delayed tranche. RMA ID: `RMA-20241105-001`. Please attach photos and failure logs to the RMA within 48h to avoid hold.

ben_logistics: Once amendment and AWB are final, I'll request AMS depot to reserve 10 staging slots for loaners and prepare return manifest for the DOA flow.

clara_ops: Action items: 1) @diego_vendor post amendment + AWB docs; 2) @ben_logistics reserve staging & update insurance; 3) @emma_sre share quick acceptance script; 4) @alice_procure confirm PO amendment signatures.

alice_procure: I'll sign amendment once doc is in, aiming before EOD. Thanks all.

emma_sre: Sharing quick checks now:

```
#!/bin/bash
# h100 quick acceptance
serial=$1
ssh root@node
nvidia-smi -q | grep -E "Product|Driver Version|ECC"
# run minimal token-bench (container)
run_token_bench --tokens 2048 --min-throughput 1200
```

clara_ops: OK, that should work. We'll gate canary traffic until loaners pass.

diego_vendor: Sending amendment + AWB docs in 10m. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:

alice_procure: Great — keep thread updated with AWB numbers and amendment link.

rma_bot: [RMA-UPDATE] `RMA-20241105-001` status -> PRE-FLIGHT_PENDING (awaiting logs/photos, deadline 48h).
